long_description:
Functional Yin Yoga + the Subtle Body is a training for anyone looking to spend more time with their practice and understand it in a deeper, more thoughtful way.

We’ll explore Yin through a functional lens—looking at how anatomy, shape, and individual differences influence the way poses feel in the body. Alongside that, we’ll bring in the Subtle Body to build awareness that goes beyond the physical and supports a more grounded, connected practice.

This 20-hour training is a good fit for both teachers and dedicated students, especially those interested in practicing and sharing yoga in ways that are more inclusive and responsive. Whether this is your first Yin training or you’ve studied it before, you’ll walk away with a clearer foundation and tools you can actually use.

Yoga Alliance teachers can receive 20 hours of Continuing Education credits.
